`GET /assets` · rate-limit category: `external_query`

**List assets**

Retrieves a paginated list of all assets supported by Fireblocks in your workspace

**Note:** We will continue to support and display the legacy ID (API ID). Since not all Fireblocks services fully support the new Assets UUID, please use only the legacy ID until further notice.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.BlockchainID` | query | `string` |  | Blockchain id of the assets |
| `params.AssetClass` | query | [`AssetClass`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#AssetClass) |  | Assets class |
| `params.Symbol` | query | `string` |  | Assets onchain symbol |
| `params.Scope` | query | [`AssetScope`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#AssetScope) |  | Scope of the assets |
| `params.Deprecated` | query | `bool` |  | Are assets deprecated |
| `params.IDs` | query | `[]string` |  | A list of asset IDs (max 100) |
| `params.PageCursor` | query | `string` |  | Next page cursor to fetch |
| `params.PageSize` | query | `float64` |  | Items per page |

**Returns:** [`*ListAssetsResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#ListAssetsResponse)

## RegisterNewAsset

```go
func (s *BlockchainsAndAssetsService) RegisterNewAsset(ctx context.Context, body *RegisterNewAssetRequest, opts ...RequestOption) (*AssetResponse, error)
```

`POST /assets` · rate-limit category: `high_compute`

**Register an asset**

Register a new asset to a workspace and return the newly created asset's details. Currently supported chains are:
- EVM based chains
- Stellar
- Algorand
- TRON
- NEAR
- Solana
- Sui
- TON

**Request body:** [`*RegisterNewAssetRequest`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#RegisterNewAssetRequest)

**Returns:** [`*AssetResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#AssetResponse)
